title: Gemini CLI Misrepresents Billing Model to Users, resulting in catastrophic billing (4'000 $ in 2 days)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a high-level complaint regarding model output quality and inaccurate claims made by the LLM response regarding API billing and quotas. Under triage guidelines, output quality complaints without actionable reproduction code or stack traces demonstrating a systemic code defect are categorized as NEEDS_INFO.
